components.allowTrivial: playFrames counts only frames after resetWindow, so it is zero until the scene has been playing; a device that never rendered reports zero.
p50 is zero until wall-clock frame deltas have been recorded; this asserts the median native frame fits a 60 ms budget.
p95 is zero before any frame is measured; nineteen native frames in twenty must fit 60 ms.
p99 is zero before any frame is measured; the worst one percent must stay under 200 ms.
playSpikes rests at zero and only rises when a frame passes 33 ms after the startup window.
The game callback section is absent until the scene runs a frame; this is the cost of this game's own per-frame work.
outsideGame is derived per frame from the wall-clock delta minus the game callback, so it exists only once frames are measured; it is the renderer, physics step and host cost.
The enemies section is recorded only while soldiers are stepping; it is zero on a scene with none.
The physics section is charged from the post-step callback and is absent until Rapier has stepped.
This is recorded only for state-changing React commits; idle refreshes never produce a sample.
